title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gstreamer1-plugins-bad-free security update
description: A stack buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the H.266/VVC parser of the gstreamer1-plugins-bad-free package used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10. This flaw could potentially allow an attacker to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. Red Hat has released an important security update to address this issue in version 1.26.7-9.el10_3.1 of the package.
